description: Save an email campaign for the owner to review: a subject, a plain-text body, the customers to email (lead_ids, each with recorded email permission) and the verified sender. Returns the campaign id and the fingerprint of this exact revision. Sends nothing; the owner approves it with approve_email_campaign and it only goes out after launch_email_campaign. Needs an admin of the business. Campaign email only goes from the business’s own verified sending domain, to customers with recorded email permission who are not on the do-not-email list, within the daily amount the business’s Kai level allows.

business_id.description: The business that sends the email.

daily_limit.description: Optional: most emails sent per day (default: the most the sender and the Kai level allow).

design.description: Optional structured email design. text must equal its rendered text version; no raw HTML. The owner approves the exact HTML and text.

lead_ids.description: The customers (lead ids) to email; each needs recorded email permission.

sender_id.description: The verified sender to send from.

name: draft_email_campaign
title: Draft Email Campaign
